summary: John Vennum, Marshall McClure, Tony Klaus, Charlie Rattinger, and two or three others set out on a several-days camping hunt, targeting hell-divers and gophers at a slough about seven miles north of Spiritwood Lake. Before departing they all signed the Murphy pledge and swore off drink — though they brought a five-gallon demijohn of snake bite medicine along for emergencies.
